Name: Protection Failure Table Extension
Description: Extends the consecutive protection-move failure lookup table in Battle.cro to include Obstruct (792), Silk Trap (852), and Burning Bulwark (908). Relocates the 18-byte packed table from 0x126D24 to free unreferenced rodata at 0x11DE6A with 13 u16 entries (26 bytes, preserving odd count for pairwise loop), retargets internal relocation entry #1027 addend at 0x145BAC (0x9D24 -> 0x0E6A), and updates loop bound immediate CMP R0, #9 to CMP R0, #13 at 0xCD230.
